title: SDI Packet Builder Synthetic Evaluation

eval_scenarios.name: 1_pinned_early_fact
eval_scenarios.description: Early pinned facts, Byzantine filler, question about early fact

eval_scenarios.name: 2_long_filler_constraint
eval_scenarios.description: DB/testing filler, critical constraint buried in middle

eval_scenarios.name: 3_open_loop_continuation
eval_scenarios.description: Open loop from benchmark test, model switch in progress

eval_scenarios.name: 4_conflicting_recent_vs_old
eval_scenarios.description: Values updated from old to new, current state query

eval_scenarios.name: 5_tool_result_preservation
eval_scenarios.description: Memory profiling tool output with exact paths/numbers

pinned_fact_preservation: all critical facts preserved verbatim across all 5 scenarios
constraint_preservation: critical constraint NEVER run inference on battery power — preserved verbatim
open_loop_preservation: both open loops from scenario 3 preserved
conflict_handling: current values primary, old values noted with (updated from...) — correct
tool_result_preservation: all exact numeric values, paths, commit hashes preserved in scenario 5
known_limitations: Filler detection is keyword-density heuristic — may miss content with different vocabulary
No automatic uncertainty marking for conflicts — requires explicit pinned fact input
Token estimate uses chars/4 — within ~20% accuracy but not tokenizer-precise
Tier auto-selection uses memory guard — Tier 0 only activates with elevated swap

recommended_next_phase.title: Connect Packet Builder to Small Model (0.5B/3B) Safe Test
recommended_next_phase.model: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Q4_K_M (380 MB, preferred) or Qwen2.5-3B-Q4_K_M (1.8 GB)
scope: Build minimal test harness using phase26g_safe_llama_runner.py approach
Run packet builder on scenario fixtures, feed packet to 0.5B model
Score output quality vs expected answers
recommended_next_phase.rationale: Packet builder validated on 5 scenarios. Next: verify compressed packet produces acceptable quality output vs uncompressed baseline on real model.
recommended_next_phase.why_not_7b: Phase 26E/26F showed 7B at larger contexts causes swap death on this machine without further harness validation.
